punchline: One hotel floor in Hong Kong linked SARS outbreaks in four cities.
thirty_sec: On 21 February 2003 a Guangzhou medical professor stayed on the ninth floor of the Metropole Hotel in Hong Kong. At least seven others on that floor were infected, and the outbreaks in Hong Kong, Toronto, Singapore and Hanoi were all linked to the hotel.
